_: The seven industry pages (/industries/<id>). Each names what a recruiter in that field reads first, the real project documentation, the working demonstrations, the conventions followed, the films and the files. lib/hubs.mjs builds them, and the field explorer on the home page (its "preview" is the picture shown there). An item is a library card ("doc": id), or has its own title, address and text. Say where the work comes from: professional work is on the CV; projects are academic or personal; Studio scenarios use example companies, and the pages say so.
